adversarial_probes.axis: seq-rollback attack — choros_app UPDATEs actor_event_seq.next_seq BACKWARD
adversarial_probes.method: As choros_app (which holds GRANT UPDATE on actor_event_seq, needed to advance the counter): roll next_seq back into an unused lower slot, then INSERT an 'approve' actor_event at a seq LOWER than an already-committed 'submit' on the same object.
adversarial_probes.result: FINDING (not a T-0019 defect) — the backward UPDATE SUCCEEDS and a forged 'approve' lands at seq=970000 ahead of submit@seq=970001; reading the trail ORDER BY seq shows approve BEFORE submit (SoD order inverted) even though wall-clock ts proves the opposite. UNIQUE(tenant_id,seq) still blocks reusing an OCCUPIED slot (23505) — it only stops collisions, not backfilling an unused lower slot. The actor_event ROWS remain immutable (trigger + privilege hold). Classification: this is the WRITER's threat surface (T-0021/E4.2), explicitly out of T-0019 scope (FR-7 'only sanctioned writer is the gateway path'; Out-of-Scope §6.2). T-0019's structural guarantee (append-only rows) is intact; the spec's order-integrity claim (NF-2) is about REWRITING a committed row, which is barred. The unsanctioned raw-SQL path that decrements next_seq is outside the frozen contract by construction.

friction.location: migrations/018_actor_event.sql:52 (GRANT ... UPDATE ON actor_event_seq TO choros_app) + the unbuilt appendActorEvent writer
friction.issue: PROBE-E: choros_app can roll actor_event_seq.next_seq backward and backfill an unused lower seq, forging SoD order (approve appears before submit when read ORDER BY seq). UNIQUE(tenant_id,seq) only blocks occupied-slot reuse, not lower-gap backfill. The append-only ROW guarantee holds; the COUNTER is unprotected against decrement.
friction.suggestion: T-0021's sanctioned writer (and/or an actor_event_seq guard) MUST make seq monotonicity tamper-resistant: either a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on actor_event_seq rejecting next_seq decrease (NEW.next_seq < OLD.next_seq), or the writer asserts the assigned seq > MAX(seq) for the (tenant_id,object) at append-time. Flag for T-0021 threat model; T-0019 ledger shape is correct as specified.
